```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import csv
from pathlib import Path
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(Path("../data/datasets.csv"))))
if rows:
    headers = rows[0].keys()
    print("| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |")
    print("|" + "---|" * len(headers))
    for r in rows:
        print("| " + " | ".join(r.values()) + " |")
```
